symptom: Lumi curation v003 became digitally silent after 14 seconds despite global peak and clipping checks passing.
root_cause: Music was delayed by 12.8 seconds before a fade using excerpt-local timestamps; fade therefore removed the delayed music. Global measurements missed the missing active interval.
fix: Apply the excerpt fade before adelay. Export new v004 with unchanged video stream; verify every 1-second window of expected music and source correspondence.
prevention: Keep source-local and timeline timestamps separate. Check every expected active audio interval in final encoded output and listen through transitions; global LUFS and CLI success do not prove music presence.
